name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) plus Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) forces door_open, and the two Precedence clauses into door_open force blocker_moved and has_door_key. Ball and key have no order between them, matching 'in either order'. No redundant Existence clauses.

texts: Eventually pick up the mission's target box (the final goal of the task).
Unlock the door (door_open) before picking up the target box.
Move the blocking ball away from the door (blocker_moved) before the door is unlocked, in either order relative to the key.
Acquire the matching key (has_door_key) before the door is unlocked, in either order relative to the ball.
